_about: Chassis / tire / drivetrain / steering parameters for the two-track vehicle model. Everything the Vehicle physics uses comes from here so that no magic numbers live in code.

wheels._todo: front_brake_bias is the static fallback used when brake_distribution is 'fixed'. With 'dynamic' the pedal is split in proportion to axle load (EBD) and the total is capped at max_brake_grip_utilisation of the tire grip budget, so the friction brakes can never lock the wheels. The handbrake is deliberately not capped.

tires._todo: Stiffness values are Pacejka-linearised placeholders; verify on a skidpad or replace with a full Pacejka model. sliding_slip_threshold is the combined-slip magnitude that counts as sliding; below low_speed_sliding_kmh the threshold rises to catastrophic_slip_threshold so slow manoeuvring cannot false-trigger.
